notes.title: Steam Workshop integration for vehicles
notes.content:
You can now upload your vehicle models to the Steam Workshop. Other players can download and play your shared models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122787/12f56a4bb2873eee8dad175e38ae1fe7bddbf6dd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Floating Bricks!
notes.content:
You can now set up vehicles as ships.
